authorization.this_delivery: literature, sanitized control metadata, code review, protocol publication

identity.signal_family: trend/time-series-momentum; same family as prior trend; not independent discovery

signal.selection: no parameter competition; reject or retain the one joint rule; do not select a different parameter per asset
signal.decision: UTC daily close t; use only closed bars; first eligible fill at t+1 hour, never same-close fill
signal.entry: one position per asset; no pyramid; eligible on initial scoring date or direction change; after stop/time exit wait for next direction change
signal.exit: zero/opposite daily direction, fixed entry stop distance 3*ATR20, or 84 calendar days; stop detection from completed prior-hour high/low or current known open; execute next legal hourly open, never assumed trigger-price fill
signal.atr: mean of last 20 true ranges, including last closed day
signal.reversal: close first; opposite entry only at next hourly open after close

risk.drawdown: inherited hourly pre-action and original funding-event observations; 10% latch half risk, 15% latch zero new risk, no peak reset or economic restart; >20% fails risk criterion, not an invented immediate-exit guarantee
risk.nominal_caps_source: design, retained from old portfolio envelope
risk.C_multiplier: min(1, median(previous 252 daily sigma20 estimates)/current closed-day sigma20), per asset; reductions only for held quantity, never increase until next natural entry
risk.quantity: floor(min(stop-risk budget/stop-distance, asset cap/entry price, available shared cash after reserves/entry price)/lot_step)*lot_step; never round up to minimum
risk.shared_wallet: B/C/half-B each one 1000 USDT wallet; simultaneous orders proportional downscale then floor, BTC first only for equal residual priority; cost/funding deducted once; no combining standalone equity curves
risk.execution_inheritance: hour-open fills only; completed prior-hour OHLC stop observation then next executable hour; do not assume intrabar stop-price fills; legal reduction failures retain actual inventory and block new risk

cost.source: inherited supervisor-adopted floors; net >=0 is explicit user target
cost.funding: actual signed event cashflow and associated mark; no default zero or proxy mark
cost.known_higher_fee: refreeze higher fee before any score; account applicable fee UNKNOWN
cost.settlement: bind existing reviewed precision and conservative cashflow consumer before native; avoid double-counting native fees/funding

train.binding: old Issue119 source registration is not this protocol registration
train.quality: BLOCKED_DATA in checked old terminal; complete current usable pool UNKNOWN

old_exposed.use: exposure disclosure only; not an extra fold or independent evidence

forward.withdrawn_v1_calendar: 2026-10-01 to 2029-10-01; not approved, not retained as deadline
forward.requirements: before independent observations, freeze legal warmup/state, dependence assessment, target precision/power, minimum information and finite calendar stop; no retrospective registration
forward.insufficient_sample: UNDERPOWERED is permissible; no automatic extension, lookback shortening or protection release

samples.withdrawn_v1_thresholds: 12 blocks and 30 merged episodes do not have a new power justification; 84-day lookback/holding cap does not establish dependence length
samples.unit: report natural asset episodes and joint overlapping episodes; hourly bars, partial reductions, native chunks and correlated assets are not independent replicates
samples.training: nominal730 days; report net costs, feasibility, turnover, exposure and dependence diagnostics if later authorized; no independent qualification from training
samples.confirmation: must predefine cost-after nonloss lower confidence bound and risk evaluation on separate future evidence; estimator/block lengths/information requirement/calendar need justification before any independent read; no parameter selection to make intervals pass
samples.C_claim: C vs B and half-B paired diagnostics only until a justified predeclared joint inference contract exists; B remains primary
samples.stop: insufficient data/source/sample -> explicit blocker or UNDERPOWERED, not threshold relaxation

stage_gates: control-only current slice; no market access
resolve source contract and complete evidence with new scoped authorization before any price read/request/native
shared technical sizing/cash/funding/risk preflight; contract or technical invalidity blocks all dependent jobs; do not confuse economic negative with technical invalidity
B base and stress first: fixed two-asset primary; valid negative B remains recorded simulated path, not a universal mechanism rejection
A-BTC and A-ETH base/stress are secondary diagnostics; either negative does not veto B, delete asset, change parameter or switch primary
C and half-B base/stress are secondary controls; technical/model/control integrity error stops dependent batch; valid negative result alone does not stop other frozen diagnostics
risk violation in a mode fails that mode; shared risk implementation defect blocks all; A mode failure alone is not evidence B violated its own limits
independent protocol must be justified and separately frozen; no forward allocation/calendar activated

native_budget.global_reconciliation: 28 consumed + 10 old sealed + 10 proposed training + 48 unallocated = 96
native_budget.failures: any reservation/attempt charges its slot even on error; no replacement keys or unmetered jobs; old technical-retry budget is not new authorization

acquisition_budget.recommendation: no repeated request while historical associated-mark source contract is unresolved; see issue139-source-audit-v2.json for conditional diagnostic ceiling and full-path arithmetic

literature_audit.deviation: One over the limit if each open invocation counts; two final calls expanded previously opened PDF and official configuration; no further retrieval. Requires supervisor acceptance, not a compliant-budget claim.

new_design_not_user_requirements.C: proposed reduction-only variant of inherited volatility factor; not identical inherited recovery
